summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests, mypy, or Black, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool after set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, with the required docstring caveats. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Still needed: run pytest, mypy, and Black to confirm.
